::: {.videos}
5MinuteAI explains [maximum likelihood estimation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Pa-GWE5JuH4)
and works [examples](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w3a08digzfw) in five minutes each,
following the University of Washington's CSE 312 [@fiveminuteai_probstat].
:::

::: {.reading}
- @hoggtanis2015 [Sec. 6.4, pp. 264--276] covers maximum likelihood and method of moments estimation.
- @CaseBerg01 [Sec. 7.2.2, pp. 315--323] covers maximum likelihood estimators.
- @rice2007mathematical [Sec. 8.5, pp. 267--284] covers the method of maximum likelihood.
:::
